title: Watermark client etl4/vault/watermark.py (get / set)
objective: Implement etl4/vault/watermark.py with get(layer, table) -> Optional[str] and set(layer, table, last_ym, row_count, conn). set() must accept an existing psycopg connection so the watermark advance travels in the caller's transaction (architecture.md section 4.1 staged UPSERT).
unblocks: T-17 (sink staged INSERT ON CONFLICT with same-txn watermark write)
T-20 (run_matrix watermark advance after a ym's cells commit)
T-22 (run_e2e pre-flight filesystem vs watermark drift check)

acceptance_criteria.statement: python -c 'import ast; ast.parse(open(watermark.py)); print(syntax OK)' prints syntax OK
python -c 'from etl4.vault.watermark import get, set; print(IMPORT OK)' prints IMPORT OK
get() on empty returns None; after set() in a txn returns the value; malformed last_ym raises CheckViolation
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Smoke script verifies: v=None pre-insert; v='2022-07' post-commit; TEST_YM_BAD ('2022-7') raised psycopg.errors.CheckViolation; post-rollback get() returns None.

acceptance_criteria.statement: set() is idempotent (same-args repeat = unchanged state except updated_at)
acceptance_criteria.evidence: first=(2022-08, 42, t1); second=(2022-08, 42, t2>=t1). last_ym and row_count unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Txn sharing: one conn does set() + sibling INSERT; rollback drops both atomically
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Mid-txn: wm visible, pipeline_runs row visible; after rollback both absent (watermark None, count 0). Commit variant confirmed: both land atomically.

commands_run.cmd: python -c "from etl4.vault.watermark import get, set; print('IMPORT OK')"

integration_points.writes: INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (layer, table_name) DO UPDATE on pipeline_watermarks; caller commits
consumers: etl4/vault/raw_vault.py (T-08 per-ym build loop; get() to find last_ym)
etl4/bench/run_matrix.py (T-20 matrix watermark advance per ym)
etl4/orchestration/rewind.py (T-21 watermark rollback via direct SQL, not this module)

notes: set() shadows Python's builtin set at module scope (as specified). Import the module, not the names (watermark.set(...)) to avoid shadowing in callers. Documented in module docstring and __all__. DSN defaults to env POSTGRES_DSN, fallback to localhost dev DSN -- matches etl4/sink/postgres.py pattern.
